::: {.meta}
{{< include charts/trade-release/output/release.md >}}

The latest monthly report on U.S. trade in goods and services, from the Census Bureau and the Bureau of Economic Analysis.

## Headline

Seasonally adjusted, balance of payments basis, billions of dollars. The revision is from the previous month's first published figure.

{{< include charts/trade-release/output/headline.md >}}

```{=html}
<picture>
  <source media="(max-width: 600px)" srcset="charts/trade-release/output/goods-balance-narrow.png">
  <img src="charts/trade-release/output/goods-balance.png" class="chart" alt="Line chart of the monthly U.S. goods trade balance on a Census basis, seasonally adjusted and not seasonally adjusted, since January 2025.">
</picture>
```

## Goods in chained dollars

Chained 2017 dollars, seasonally adjusted, Census basis, billions of dollars a month. The quarter so far against the previous quarter, the comparison that feeds quarterly GDP.

{{< include charts/trade-release/output/real-goods.md >}}

## Computers, chips, and telecom equipment by country

These imports bear on estimates of AI investment and its effect on GDP. The chart shows the eight largest sources; the product groups match the [goods balance chart](trade.qmd#goods-trade-balance).

```{=html}
<picture>
  <source media="(max-width: 600px)" srcset="charts/trade-release/output/hardware-by-country-narrow.png">
  <img src="charts/trade-release/output/hardware-by-country.png" class="chart" alt="Dot plots of monthly U.S. imports of computers and parts, and of semiconductors and telecom equipment, by country, in the latest month and a year earlier.">
</picture>
```

## By country

Goods balance with the twelve largest partners either way, Census basis, billions of dollars. Seasonally adjusted except the change from a year earlier.

{{< include charts/trade-release/output/partners.md >}}

## Tariffs

The tariff rate is duties as a percent of the value of imports for consumption.

```{=html}
<picture>
  <source media="(max-width: 600px)" srcset="charts/trade-release/output/duties-narrow.png">
  <img src="charts/trade-release/output/duties.png" class="chart" alt="Bar chart of monthly calculated duties on U.S. imports over the past two years, with the latest month highlighted.">
</picture>
```

{{< include charts/trade-release/output/duties-by-country.md >}}

::: {.chart-source}
Source: Census Bureau, U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services (FT-900), exhibits 1, 6, 10, and 19, and U.S. imports and exports of merchandise by end-use category, product, and country. Data: [goods balance](charts/trade-release/output/goods-balance.csv), [categories](charts/trade-release/output/end-use-changes.csv), [products](charts/trade-release/output/product-changes.csv), [computers and chips by country](charts/trade-release/output/hardware-by-country.csv), [countries](charts/trade-release/output/partners.csv), [duties](charts/trade-release/output/duties.csv).
:::
